import json,time,subprocess,sys,os,signal
b=Path.home()/'sponge-sim'/'pi3b_600mhz_swapguard_v2';sys.path.insert(0,str(b));import control
r=b/'runs'/'qa_c_childkill_01'

 if (r/'qa_ready.json').exists():break

control.record(r/'qa_fault_result.json',dict(action='SIGKILL_child',pid=pid,signal_sent=True),True)
